thesis: Use the same architecture we want to sell: sense demand, propose a product/action, simulate/backtest cheaply, expose the minimum real offer, observe sell-through, and accumulate a reusable outcome dataset.
hard_boundary: simulation/backtest may decide what to try; only external outcomes update demand/economic/scarce-state performance.
use_for_breadup_customer_product: The accumulated dataset becomes the empirical substrate for pricing, channel choice, sell-speed estimates, product sourcing and future user recommendations.
